// about_me

Developer. Creator.
Community builder.

I'm Phiwokuhle Lihle Nkohla — a freshly graduated developer from Emeris (formerly Varsity College), Nelson Mandela Bay. My journey into tech has been driven by a love for building things that are both functional and beautiful.

Beyond the screen, I serve my church community as a live media presenter using ProPresenter, handling broadcasting software and AV coordination. I'm also a Virtual Assistant trained through ALX Africa, bringing digital organisation and remote collaboration skills to the table.

I believe technology is at its best when it connects people — whether through a polished app, a live broadcast, or a beautifully designed interface. I'm ready to bring that energy to a team that cares about craft.
